meta.title: Supplier Portal — Demo Ingredient Trading Co.
meta.description: Enterprise Platform Phase 7 WEB-04 demo — an authenticated Supplier/RFQ portal: real per-supplier RFQs, quotations, purchase orders, deliveries, documents and qualification status, backed by real Frappe session login and per-supplier permission scoping.

login.heading: Supplier Portal
login.subhead: Sign in with your supplier account to see your own RFQs, quotations, purchase orders, deliveries, documents and qualification status.
login.footerNote: This is a public demo platform — use the Demo Access credentials above to explore freely.

demoBox.heading: Demo Access
demoBox.description: Try it now with real seeded demo accounts — no real business data at stake.

errors.not_provisioned: This account is not a provisioned supplier login.
errors.invalid_request: Please fill in all required fields and try again.
errors.not_logged_in: You've been signed out. Please sign in again.
errors.network: Could not reach the portal. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

dashboard.loggedInAs: Logged in as {user}. Supplier-scoped data only — never another supplier's.

rfqs.title: My RFQs
rfqs.desc: RFQs you've been invited to respond to.

quotations.title: My Quotations
quotations.desc: Every quotation you've submitted, RFQ-linked or not.

deliveries.heading: My Deliveries
deliveries.subhead: Only Purchase Receipts (delivery/shipment records) for {supplierName} — never another supplier's — with each shipment's own real Quality Inspection result.

documents.heading: Documents
documents.subhead: Real document references tied to {supplierName}'s own relationship — RFQ invitations, quotations, purchase orders, delivery receipts and quality inspection certificates. Not a document-management system (see this platform's DMS demo for that) — every row here links to a real transactional record this supplier already owns.

purchaseOrders.heading: My Purchase Orders
purchaseOrders.subhead: Only Purchase Orders issued to {supplierName} — never another supplier's.

qualification.heading: Qualification Status
qualification.subhead: {supplierName}'s own quality status only — never another supplier's.
qualification.note: Quality status and critical-supplier flag are set through this platform's internal AI-assisted procurement review workflow (a human always reviews and approves any change — this portal only displays your own current, already-decided status; it cannot change it).

quotations.heading: My Quotations
quotations.subhead: Only Supplier Quotations belonging to {supplierName} — never another supplier's. Includes quotations submitted with or without an inviting RFQ.

rfqs.heading: My RFQs
rfqs.subhead: Only Request for Quotations inviting {supplierName} — never another supplier's. Every RFQ on this platform names exactly one supplier, by design (see this app's README).

detail.alreadyResponded: You've already responded to this RFQ — see My Quotations for your submission.
